measurement.consent: Share aggregate purchase-step counts to help improve Buy XOR. No wallet addresses, amounts or transaction hashes are sent.
measurement.privacy: Your browser privacy preference keeps these counts off.
measurement.unavailable: Step counts could not be sent. Your purchase is unaffected.

buyXor.title: Buy XOR
buyXor.subtitle: Get XOR into your SORA wallet using card or crypto.
buyXor.mainnetRequired: Switch Polkaswap to SORA mainnet to buy XOR.
buyXor.cardRouteNotice: Your card buys ETH through MoonPay. You then convert and transfer funds to SORA, and swap to XOR.
buyXor.cardDestinationNote: Use this Ethereum address at checkout. Your SORA receiving wallet is a different address.
buyXor.walletsIntroduction: Connect your payment wallet first, then the SORA wallet that will receive your XOR.
buyXor.walletsDescription: Your XOR will be held in this SORA wallet. Keep access to it and protect your recovery information.
buyXor.createClaimWallet: Create or connect your SORA wallet
buyXor.swapDescription: Your DAI amount is filled in. Review the latest quote and network fee to receive XOR in your SORA wallet.
buyXor.initialEstimate: Initial estimate · refreshed before the swap
buyXor.receivingNotice: XOR is delivered to your SORA wallet. You can hold, send or use it after the swap is confirmed.
buyXor.receivedDescription: Your swap is confirmed on SORA. Your wallet now controls the received XOR.
buyXor.optionalTs: Optional: burn XOR for a future TS claim
buyXor.optionalTsNotice: This is a separate action. Burning destroys XOR permanently; TS is claimed later.
buyXor.swapReceived: Swap confirmed. XOR was received by your SORA wallet.
buyXor.existingXor: View existing XOR in my wallet

routes.card: Card → ETH on Ethereum → DAI → transfer to SORA → XOR in your wallet. Requires Ethereum and SORA wallets. MoonPay controls eligibility, identity checks, minimums and final fees.
routes.ethereum: ETH or USDT on Ethereum mainnet → DAI → transfer to SORA → XOR in your wallet. Existing Ethereum DAI skips conversion. Keep ETH for network fees.
routes.ton: Native TON first needs an external TON-to-USDT swap. USDT on TON → ETH on Ethereum through Symbiosis → DAI → transfer to SORA → XOR in your wallet. The provider handles the TON transfer and its recovery. Keep TON and ETH for network fees.
routes.sora: DAI in your SORA wallet → swap to XOR. The estimate accounts for the SORA swap fee.

buyXor.bridgePreparationError: This funding route could not be prepared. Check your network and wallet connection, then return to Buy XOR to try again.
buyXor.walletEntryDescription: Add XOR to your SORA wallet with card or crypto.

preview.netXor: After estimated SORA swap fees and a price buffer.
preview.xorBudget: XOR already in your SORA wallet
preview.cardEth: MoonPay currently estimates {eth} ETH delivered. Keep some ETH for gas; spending it on fees will reduce the eventual XOR amount.
preview.method: This is an indicative plan, refreshed every 30 seconds. Estimates include a conservative conversion and slippage buffer. Provider amounts, gas and rates can change before the final review.
preview.notice: This route acquires XOR on SORA mainnet. Review every transaction before signing.

reason.fees-insufficient: This amount would not leave spendable XOR after the swap fee. Try a larger amount.
reason.fees-unavailable: The current SORA swap fee is unavailable, so a net XOR estimate would be incomplete.

liquidity.ready: About {xor} XOR available after the swap fee
liquidity.allowed: This estimate meets the price-impact limit and leaves spendable XOR after the estimated swap fee. Rates and fees can change.
liquidity.feeReserve: Estimated swap fee: {fees} XOR. Conservative spendable amount: {spendable} XOR.
liquidity.feesUnavailable: Waiting for the current swap fee from SORA mainnet.
liquidity.feesInsufficient: This amount would not leave spendable XOR after the swap fee. Increase the DAI amount and check again; it must also stay within the 5% price-impact limit.

buyXor.resumeDescription: Return to your purchase plan to review the next step. Each transaction needs your approval.
